title: Navigate the authoritative star catalogue with keyboard and pointer
description: A real waiting member filters the authoritative catalogue, uses keyboard camera controls, selects a named star and tests map-label clipping at the inspector boundary. No home exists before scheduled start. Fixed catalogue entropy makes the scene repeatable without invented star data or gameplay actions.

steps.description: Create and join a waiting development campaign through ordinary sign-in/create/join controls. Grant emulator developer access and use the test loader’s fixed catalogue entropy. No scheduler or production clock is advanced.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Inspect the waiting galaxy before a home has been assigned.
steps.acknowledgement: The real canvas and selected system are visible.
verifications: The map fills the viewport under a slim campaign rail.
System names remain separated and contained as the actual camera and class filter change.
